truth_policy: MWORKS/Sysplorer remains the source of control, planning, collision, disturbance and metrics truth. Unreal renders project-owned scene profiles and may not feed hidden global geometry back to the planner.

profiles.purpose: local perception, unknown-map obstacle avoidance and replanning under vegetation-like occlusion
implementation_steps: create or select authorized visual assets
write scene_asset_registry entry with source and license note
create matching world_geometry/collision proxies
add scenario profile and planner visibility rule
run Unreal bridge checks
run short MWORKS playback or dry-run stream
perform manual viewport/video review
acceptance: radar sector shows only currently sensed region
local plan is not a fixed straight line through obstacles
